# Parse each song string into title and artists
import re

def parse_song(song_str):
    # Format: "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    parts = song_str.split(" by ")
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists_str = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(",") if a.strip()]
    return title, artists

# We'll iterate over songs_list[1:] (first already added)
for song in songs_list[1:]:
    title, artists = parse_song(song)
    print(f"Searching for: {song}")
    search_result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=song, access_token=spotify_access_token)
    # Find the first result that matches title and all artists
    matched_song = None
    for item in search_result:
        item_title = item['title']
        item_artists = [a['name'] for a in item['artists']]
        # Check if title matches and all artists are present
        if item_title.lower() == title.lower() and all(any(artist.lower() == a.lower() for a in item_artists) for artist in artists):
            matched_song = item
            break
    if matched_song:
        song_id = matched_song['song_id']
        print(f"Matched song_id: {song_id} - {matched_song['title']} by {', '.join([a['name'] for a in matched_song['artists']])}")
        add_result = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=song_id, access_token=spotify_access_token)
        print(f"Add result: {add_result}")
    else:
        print(f"No exact match found for: {song}")
        # Fallback: try searching with just the title
        search_title = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_access_token)
        print(f"Fallback search results for title '{title}': {search_title}")
        # Pick first result if any

            print(f"Add result: {add_result}")
        else:
            print(f"No results for title '{title}'")
